nbtedit.disclaimer: NBT Edit writes straight into the world files. Only change what you understand: a wrong value or a broken structure can make the game reset or throw away that data when the world loads, up to a whole player or the world itself. Backups are off by default, turn them on with the Backups control in the top right corner before editing anything valuable.
